title: pvDecimatePolyline
body:
## pvDecimatePolyline

Reduces the points of polylines by repeatedly deleting the interior vertex with the smallest error until TargetReduction (ParaView default 0.9) of the segments is removed or the next deletion would exceed MaximumError. The error comes from DecimationStrategy: distance of a vertex from the line through its neighbours (Decimation Distance Strategy, default), the angle at the vertex, or a custom point array. End points are kept, but closed loops can collapse to one segment. Use it to simplify streamlines, contours or GIS polylines.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Separate two-point line cells have no interior vertices; join them into polylines first with pvTriangleStrips and JoinContiguousSegments.
- Vertices shared by several polylines are treated independently, which can break junctions.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `DecimatePolyline`. Identity: `filters/DecimatePolyline`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DecimationStrategy` | This property determines which decimation strategy to use for the poly line decimation. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Decimation Angle Strategy","Decimation Custom Field Strategy","Decimation Distance Strategy"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Decimation Angle Strategy"}` |
| `MaximumError` | Set the largest decimation error that is allowed during the decimation process. This may limit the maximum reduction that may be achieved. The maximum error is specified as a fraction of the maximum length of the input data bounding box. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `TargetReduction` | This property specifies the desired reduction in the total number of lines in the output dataset. For example, if the TargetReduction value is 0.9, the Decimate Polyline filter will attempt to produce an output dataset that is 10% the size of the input. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |

No authored options.

If no point array of that name exists, the filter warns that the strategy is not in a valid state and returns an empty output (no points or lines). | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
